body:
Pick the stack for the album ranking app and commit a runnable empty scaffold, so every other ticket has something to build on. Follows the stack and shape decisions in the MVP spec (#2).

## Today
The repo has only a README, `.gitignore` and the agent team docs. No code, no test or lint commands (`docs/agents/project.md` § Commands says `none yet`).

## Scope
- Choose the language, framework, package manager and test runner. The shape is fixed by the spec: one web app with a small server and one SQLite file, run on localhost. Write the choice and the reason in a short doc under `docs/`.
- Commit a scaffold that starts locally with one command and shows a blank home page.
- Add one passing smoke test and the commands to run it, a linter and a typecheck if the stack has them.
- Fill the `Test`, `Lint` and `Typecheck` rows in `docs/agents/project.md` § Commands, and the Areas list in § Areas and labels, so later tickets can use them.
- Add a README section for running the app.
- Read config from environment variables, so deploying later needs no rework. No secrets in the repo. Add a `.env.example` if the app reads config.

## Acceptance
- A fresh clone runs the app and the test command with the steps in the README.
- `docs/agents/project.md` § Commands has real values for Test, Lint and Typecheck.
- The stack choice is written down with the reason.

## Out of scope
- Any album, ranking or rating features.
- Database tables (see the data model ticket).
- CI, deployment and a password gate (the deployment ticket).
title: Choose the tech stack and scaffold the app
